description: Scenario / conditions that set up the power solution — the machine-readable companion to docs/requirements.md. Every field has a value, unit, definition, and status (known | assumption | open | derived). 'derived' fields are computed from the others via docs/sizing-methodology.md and should be recomputed if inputs change. Edit here to retarget; keep in sync with docs/requirements.md.

meta.use_case: Cool a shaded desert tent while sleeping during the day, off a DIY solar + LiFePO4 system.

location.definition: Install location; drives sun and cooling demand.

peak_sun_hours.definition: Equivalent full-sun hours; design around the worst usable value.

outside_temp_night.definition: Typical overnight low (big desert diurnal swing).

relative_humidity.definition: Dry air — refrigerant AC dehumidifies; evaporative would add humidity.

dust_exposure.definition: Drives sealed enclosure + filter cleaning needs.

shading.definition: Already out of direct sun — the single biggest load reducer.

added_insulation.definition: Reflective tarp/insulation are parked efficiency add-ons (docs/efficiency-backlog.md); not assumed in sizing.

air_leakage.definition: Tent leaks; keeps duty cycle high, so don't count on the low end.

occupancy.definition: Occupant sensible/latent heat load (~100 W each).

ac_cooling_capacity.definition: Target AC size; oversized for a shaded tent but keeps a reliability margin (decisions/0004).

ac_running_power.definition: Typical AC draw while cooling; MEASURE with a clamp meter to confirm — this drives array size.

ac_duty_cycle.definition: Fraction of the cooling window the compressor actually runs (leaky tent + heat -> high).

cooling_required.definition: Active refrigerant AC is the required core; must hit comfort + low humidity on its own.

cooling_hours.definition: Hours the AC runs per day.

overnight_cooling.definition: Desert nights are cool; no overnight cooling by design.

total_daily_energy.definition: Sum of all non-AC loads; keep the AC dominant.

cloudy_day_bridge.definition: Days of reduced-solar (overcast) operation the battery should carry beyond the daily buffer. 0 = daytime solar-direct only; raising this is the main lever that grows the battery.

battery_buffer_runtime.definition: AC-only runtime the buffer battery must cover (surge + passing clouds + shoulders of solar noon).

cloudy_derate.definition: Fraction of nameplate solar yield on a heavily overcast day (for bridge sizing).

usable_depth_of_discharge.definition: LiFePO4 daily DoD used to convert usable Wh to nominal battery kWh.

system_voltage.definition: Battery bus voltage — still undecided (decisions/0002); ties AC unit, cells, panels, inverter together.

battery_chemistry.definition: LiFePO4 only (safety, cycle life, deep DoD).

inverter_waveform.definition: Required on the AC-inverter path (AC compressors need pure sine).

portability.definition: Packs down, quick setup/teardown, wind- & dust-hardened.

budget_ceiling.definition: Total parts budget cap — set to constrain part choices.

derived_targets.note: Computed from the inputs above via docs/sizing-methodology.md. Recompute if inputs change.

ac_daily_energy.definition: ac_running_power x cooling_hours x ac_duty_cycle (~500 W x 8 h x 0.9).

array_size.definition: Sized to run the AC live through the solar window + recover the buffer (~design_daily_energy / (PSH x ~0.72), rounded up).

battery_buffer.definition: Buffer for surge/clouds/shoulders at 80% DoD; grows if cloudy_day_bridge > 0.

inverter_size.definition: AC-inverter path only: >= peak simultaneous running W x 1.25 (soft-start AC unit -> mild surge).

mppt_current.definition: array_W / system_voltage x 1.25 (recompute once system_voltage is chosen).
